quest.title: The Gourmet Supremos: Cook-Off
quest.description: Xudong, leader of the Gourmet Supremos, seems to be getting ready to have a cook-off with Kamei Munehisa...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Get ready now, this dish is going to be amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: My dish shall be similarly fantastic, so prepare yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you two doing?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Hello, Traveler. Parvaneh and Julie are out gathering ingredients, and we were supposed to prepare a meal for them...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: But Uncle Munehisa and I had a minor disagreement about what to prepare.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: So we decided to each come up with a dish for a competition. The winner will get to set the theme for today's meals.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: I'm making one of Liyue's specialties, Jewelry Soup.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: And I shall make my best dish, Tri-Flavored Skewer.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Well, if you have time, we do need a judge...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: But since both of us need to prepare four servings of each dish despite only having two hands, we are a little overwhelmed.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: You can help us prepare the food before the judging begins.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: And of course, you can pick what dish to help with, since you are only one person.

choices.text: Xudong, will you be able to handle it alone?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Don't worry about me. I used to run a restaurant in Liyue, so it's not hard for me to prepare a meal.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: That said, with a little help, I could make the food even better.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Anyway, just pick a dish that interests you.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Oh! That's great, Uncle Munehisa, be prepared to be defeated by my dish!

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: I am not a man who gives up easily. Go ahead and do your best.

choices.text: Uncle Munehisa, I'll help you out.

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: Thank you, Xudong, be prepared.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: No problem. Go ahead and do your best.

choices.text: Uncle Munehisa, will you be able to handle it alone?

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: Don't worry. Just pick whoever you prefer. When I was in the Shogunate, I used to prepare meals for a lot of people all by myself. This is just four servings.

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: But if you want to help me, I'm sure I can make the dish even better.

choices.text: I suppose you're short one judge, then.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Hahaha, that's right. We need a judge to try them.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Done. Thank you, Traveler. It smells so good.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: I'll try it first... Wow, that's great. The ingredients are cooked just right and it smells perfect.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: You could even call this a "Perfect Jewelry Soup."

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Okay, Uncle Munehisa, how's your cooking going? Ready to show it to the Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Well... I made a mistake. I realized that I didn't have enough Bird Eggs right after I started.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Although I did immediately go to get some Bird Eggs from the woods, the other ingredients were past their best by then.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Tri-Flavored Skewers made with ingredients that aren't fresh can no longer be considered a good meal.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: I am ashamed to have been so negligent. I need to refine my skills more.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: You win this time. But next time, Xudong, I will definitely beat you.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Haha, I promise that I won't be an easy opponent.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: By the way Traveler, these are for you. Thank you for helping us all this time.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Make sure to come next time we compete, too.

choices.text: Actually, I think it tastes alright...

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: I am not satisfied with just "alright." Even in cooking, one has to have the heart to pursue perfection.

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: This is the only way to become a master of the art of cooking.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Ah, I see. Exactly... That's exactly it!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's right!

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: The art of the sword and the art of cooking are the same in this regard, and to me, they are both part of the art of existence.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Great! Uh, way to go, Uncle Munehisa... I believe in you. Yeah...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Uh... I have no idea how to deal with someone who is so... serious. I guess only Julie can, but she's not here right now...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Honestly, I'm pretty shocked too.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: *cough* Well, thank you for your hard work, Traveler. Please take these. I—

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: Xudong, I'd like to ask you a few more questions about cooking. Do you have a moment?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Huh? Oh, right, yes! I'll be there! I'll be right there...

talks.objective: Help Kamei Munehisa cook Tri-Flavored Skewer

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Hmm. The smell and how it looks... these Three Flavored Skewers should be called Extreme Skewers instead!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Extreme... Skewers?

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Hehe, I simply mean that it's a perfect dish... Well, would you look at the time. Xudong's Jewelry Soup should be ready now.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Of course! Here is my Jewelry Soup.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: It might be a bit overcooked because I didn't handle the timing perfectly, but the taste should be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Let me taste it.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Well, it does have a slightly burnt taste. It's not bad enough to ruin the whole pot, but it is still a flaw in the end.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I was in a hurry this time. Next time, I'll prepare all the ingredients in advance, so this won't happen.

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: You win this time, but rest assured that I won't make the same mistake next time.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Hahaha... Yeah, I was careless. I'll have to be more mindful next time...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: By the way Traveler, these are for you. Thank you for helping us all this time.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Make sure to come next time we compete, too.

choices.text: Uncle Munehisa's Extreme Skewers have won the day.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Extreme Skewers? What does that mean?

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: It means that these Tri-Flavored Skewer are of perfect quality.

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: To have an "extreme" pursuit means that your heart can never satisfied with mere "acceptability." Instead, the highest perfection is the goal.

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: Even in cooking, one must have the heart to pursue perfection. This is the only way to become a master of the art of cooking.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Ah, I see. Exactly... That's exactly it!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's right!

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: The art of the sword and the art of cooking are the same in this regard, and to me, they are both part of the art of existence.

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: Come, Xudong. Allow me to tell you about the "extreme" path.

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Huh? O—Okay. Just give me a second, I'll be right there. Traveler, here is your payment...

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Uh... I have no idea how to deal with someone who is so... serious. I guess only Julie can, but she's not here right now...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Just go get the Extreme Cookery experience.

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: Xudong?

response.speaker: Xudong
response.text: Huh? I'm coming. Just a second! I'll be right there...

talks.objective: Help Xudong turn up the heat

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: How did it go? Did you get some Snapdragon?

talks.objective: Help Kamei Munehisa turn down the heat

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: How did it go? Did you get Bird Eggs?

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Then let's get started. Jewelry Soup requires Snapdragon, Tofu, and Lotus Heads...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Lotus Heads and Tofu... Luckily, there's still some left. But there's not enough Snapdragon...

dialogues.speaker: Xudong
dialogues.text: Traveler, I'll be handling the ingredients. Just in case, can you please get me three more servings of Fresh Snapdragon?

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: Thank you for your willingness to help. Tri-Flavored Skewer is simple to prepare, but it requires extra attention to the freshness of the ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
dialogues.text: I've gotten enough of every ingredient except Bird Eggs... Could you please fetch two fresh eggs for me, just in case?

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: Thank you.

choices.text: How did you learn to make this?

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: When I was still serving in the Shogunate, I used to make this sort of small dish to go with wine.

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: But now...

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: Anyway, let's not talk about the past. I'm counting on you for the Bird Eggs.

response.speaker: Kamei Munehisa
response.text: I will be dealing with the ingredients here. Please bring the Bird Eggs to me as soon as you have them.

talks.objective: Give the Fresh Snapdragons to Xudong
Give the Fresh Bird Eggs to Kamei Munehisa
